decisions.decision: Use Motion Forge as the shared human, mob, boss, combat and interaction review surface.
decisions.rationale: It keeps actor catalogs, timing, contact and reactions shared instead of building disconnected preview tools.

decisions.decision: Use capability-driven controls and DRY shared infrastructure with actor-specific calibration.
decisions.rationale: Irrelevant controls must disappear while skeleton, weapon and creature-specific contacts remain correct.

decisions.decision: Use source-preserving GLB surgery for strict boss repairs.
decisions.rationale: Full-scene Blender export and shared-joint donor skins changed protected data and caused deterministic review failures.

decisions.decision: Do not start dungeon integration until all mobs and bosses pass the review tool.
decisions.rationale: The owner explicitly ordered full mob completion and boss review before dungeon integration.
